title: Chinese Merchants Meeting

Shanghai Municipal Police.
650
91. Typ
West Hongkew Station.
17-10-1916
REPORT ON " Chinese Merchants' Meeting "
Made by J.W.Prince D.C. Forwarded by Inspector W. Mason.
Sir,
I beg to report that at 4 P.M, to-day a meeting of
Shanghai 'Chinese Merchants 'was held in the 'Chamber of Commerce
Building at N'th Honan Rd, about (50) Merchants attended to
discuss the proposition of raising money to relieve, distressed
Revolutionary Followers at present in Shanghai, with a view to
sending them to their Native homes. No decision was come to,
owing, it was stated, to the Shanghai Tao-Tai's disapproval of
having to pay out such a large sum of money as is required.
The meeting was quite peaceful. It is proposed to hold another
meeting at 4 P.M, tomorrow 18'th, when, it is stated, only about
five or six persons will attend.
To/
S.D. Inspector
C.I.D, Office
Central.
I am Sir
Yours Obediently
J.W. Prince
Det' Serg't.

虹口西区捕房。
1916年10月17日
关于“中国商人会议”的报告
由警佐 J.W. Prince 撰写，经督察 W. Mason 转呈。

先生：

谨此报告，今日下午四时，一批“中国商人”在河南路（北段）的“商会大楼”举行会议，约有（50）名商人出席，讨论筹款以救济目前身处上海的困顿革命党追随者，并拟将他们遣送回乡的方案。据称，由于上海道台不赞成支付如此巨额的款项，会议未达成任何决议。
会议过程十分平和。据悉，计划于明日（18日）下午四时再行召开会议，届时据称仅有约五六人出席。

致
刑事侦缉处总监
中央办事处

先生，
您忠实的仆人
J.W. Prince
警佐
